blocks.html: No condition shall be created as a result of construction or demolition operations that will interfere with natural surface drainage. Water courses, drainage ditches, etc., shall not be obstructed by debris, refuse, waste building materials, earth, stones, tree stumps, branches, or other objects that may interfere with surface drainage or cause the impoundment of surface waters.
